svg.title: Match each task to the team member who may perform it in a typical acute care setting. Scope of practice is set by each state's nurse practice act, so confirm the details where you work.
svg.desc: Assistive personnel perform standardized, predictable tasks for stable clients and report what they observe back to the nurse. Practical nurses reinforce teaching and carry out many procedures, but the initial assessment and the care plan require the registered nurse's judgment and cannot be handed off. The exact boundary between registered nurse and practical nurse practice moves from state to state, so the nurse practice act where you are licensed is the final authority.
